text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The Turbo Call! See, when I win, I wanna
have
everyone call my name, just like
King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Repeating one's name and praising
oneself
prompts the fans to follow along.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A first-rate runner's first-rate call will
captivate
fans and show them what to
do. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The fans? Psh. You don't need to do a

demonstration.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just say, "Shut up and follow me."
They'll be as
good as lemmings.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Let Turbo try! ...Shaddup and follow
Turbo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, not half bad... Silence, and follow
my lead!
